name: omnilab/quickgo
description: Omnilab QuickGO: a Gene Ontology term (GO:0005829) - its name, definition, aspect, synonyms, comment, obsolescence, direct parents by relation and children - a UniProt protein with the GO terms it is annotated to by aspect and evidence, its annotations with their evidence, reference and curator, and a search of terms, through the EBI's QuickGO services, no key needed.
